requests: Whether it is possible to use a 3300 PSI pressure washer with a soft-wash nozzle to apply the cleaner, with the cleaner introduced downstream through a dispenser rather than through the pump
Whether there is any reason not to use the pressure washer to apply the cleaner
What the preferred method of applying the cleaner is
reason: The reply says yes, the pressure washer can be used and the soap will work. It gives reasons not to use it: lifting wood fibers, soaking the wood so it needs days to dry, and the risk of being pushed off a ladder. It names a preferred method, a brush on a painter's extension pole. It does not discuss the downstream dispenser setup specifically, but its general yes covers whether the approach is possible, so all three questions are addressed.
